test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

__We are decorate__ the living - room at the moment.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**are decorate**."
 
• The correct form should be the present continuous "**are decorating**."
 
• Present continuous tense is used to indicate actions happening at the moment of speaking.
 
• Thus, the error is in the verb form used in the sentence.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We **are decorating **the living-room at the moment."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "We are being decorating"** – This option is incorrect because "being" is unnecessary and incorrect in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "We are decorates"** – This option is incorrect because "decorates" is not the correct form of the verb to use with "are".
 
• **Option 3: "We are being decorate"** – This option is incorrect because the structure is grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "We are decorating"** – This is the correct option as it properly uses the present continuous tense.
